name: suede-ship-copy
description: Suede AI copy-only orchestration DAG for one high-stakes piece strangers will read that has to be true: a landing page, launch post, blog post, email, X thread, docs page, README, ad, or store listing. About thirty agents run research lenses, a claim audit, blind angles, parallel section writers, adversarial refutation, and a publish readiness gate, and return a draft file plus an evidence record. The audit targets what the agents invent, never what the requester supplied: their own statements a
author: JasonColapietro
